title: Weakly contractible refinement of a finite etale covering cone
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u, P_n finite etale X-schemes and p_n:P_(n+1)→P_n X-maps. Suppose that for every separably closed field Ω in universe u and geometric point Spec Ω→X all fibers of P_n are finite and nonempty. There exists a pro-etale covering family U_j→X indexed by Type u, whose sources are affine and weakly contractible on the full small pro-etale site, with X-maps a_jn:U_j→P_n such that a_j(n+1)≫p_n=a_jn for every j,n. No surjectivity assumption on p_n is made. Definitions: [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks].

source.place: Tags 0983, 098H and 0990; original compatible-trivializations step 5, with a Type u index.

proof.text: Cover each source by its affine open cover. For each affine ring choose a singleton faithfully flat ind-etale contractible extension. Bind the covers twice, without a universe lift. Each refined object is affine and weakly contractible in the full site. Precompose every cone projection with the refinement arrow; associativity preserves the transition equations.

theorem finite_etale_tower_cover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (P : ℕ → X.Etale) (p : ∀ n : ℕ, P (n + 1) ⟶ P n)
    (hfin : ∀ n : ℕ, IsFinite (P n).hom)
    (hpoints : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω]
      (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) (n : ℕ),
      Finite ((pointSmallEtale x).fiber.obj (P n)) ∧
        Nonempty ((pointSmallEtale x).fiber.obj (P n))) :
    ∃ (J : Type u) (U : J → X.ProEt),
      Presieve.ofArrows (fun j ↦ (U j).left) (fun j ↦ (U j).hom) ∈
          proetalePrecoverage X ∧
      (∀ j : J, IsAffine (U j).left) ∧
      (∀ j : J, (ProEt.topology X).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1} (U j)) ∧
      ∃ a : ∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ), U j ⟶ (toProEt X).obj (P n),
        ∀ (j : J) (n : ℕ), a j (n + 1) ≫ (toProEt X).map (p n) = a j n
